title: Conduct of Proceeding before District Commission
description: Conduct of proceeding by President and members of District Commission

steps.step: The President and at least one member of the District Commission conduct the proceeding together
If a member is unable to continue, the President and the other member continue the proceeding from the stage at which it was last heard by the previous member
